resize_pil_image: resize a PIL Image to dimensions divisible by a given patch size using LANCZOS resampling
resize_pil_with_custom_patch: resize a PIL Image to a custom patch size and return original and feature dimensions
review_resize_pil: review the resize_pil function to understand how it rounds dimensions to patch size multiples
summarize_resize_pil: summarize the resize_pil function that returns resized image, original size, and feature map dimensions
test_resize_pil: test the resize_pil function with a PIL Image to verify patch-aligned resizing and returned dimensions
